result.brief: 提出共享视觉动作接口（action views），用URDF渲染关节配置统一多具身动作表示，使观测与动作共享视频自编码器与扩散Transformer，支持前向/逆向动力学与联合生成。
result.reason: Builds a world model for joint video-action modeling across embodiments with masked flow-matching, action-conditioned multiview prediction, and closed-loop manipulation planning.
